rules.name: Pressure profile
rules.applicability: full-head top-pour hydrostatic only; z from base

rules.name: Integrate tributary band
rules.applicability: allocation not analyzed support reaction

rules.name: Sheathing to stud
rules.applicability: one-way tributary assumption must match joints and edges

rules.name: Stud to waler
rules.equation_or_scope: R_stud at each support -> point loads on waler
rules.applicability: actual support continuity and loading

rules.name: Simple-span UDL
rules.applicability: single span uniform load, no overhang

rules.name: Two equal continuous spans
rules.applicability: two equal spans, same EI, both fully loaded, no settlement

rules.name: General member reaction
rules.equation_or_scope: K*u=f and equilibrium with actual springs/supports
rules.applicability: not implemented general solver in package

rules.name: Tie axial tension
rules.applicability: aligned symmetric case; not 2R; not R/2 per outer rod

rules.name: Serial elastic extension
rules.applicability: no unmeasured connection slip or sleeve shortening invented

rules.name: Axial stress indicator
rules.applicability: stress area definition must match source; not capacity

rules.name: Legacy allowable stress
rules.applicability: never apply automatically to proprietary threaded/cone assembly

rules.name: Matched design stress route
rules.applicability: requires correct design code, areas, factors, limit state

rules.name: Inner body/neck
rules.applicability: unknown grade cannot be back-calculated from breaking rating

rules.name: End-thread pull-out
rules.applicability: actual engagement/geometry/strength; do not assume pi*d*L alone

rules.name: Outer rod / nut
rules.applicability: both sides independently carry full serial tension

rules.name: Cone/sleeve function
rules.equation_or_scope: structural insert vs former; compression during tightening
rules.applicability: plastic name does not establish structural role

rules.name: Bearing stress indicator
rules.applicability: actual contact not full bounding rectangle

rules.name: Plate simple-strip benchmark
rules.applicability: plain strip/no hole reduction; not ribbed/cast plate capacity

rules.name: Plate complete checks
rules.applicability: custom/cast/rib geometry must have rule or rated test

rules.name: Waler local checks
rules.applicability: paired members need actual connection/load split

rules.name: Assembly weakest link
rules.equation_or_scope: NR=minimum capacities reduced to common axial tie demand
rules.applicability: series same demand basis & full list & compatible parts; no series force halving

rules.name: Published rating use
rules.applicability: do not use breaking strength or mix load bases

rules.name: Length stack
rules.applicability: wall minus cover is not automatic cutting length

rules.name: Installation/reuse/seal
rules.applicability: no generic welding/heating/length+10mm rule

rules.name: Equilibrium/coverage
rules.equation_or_scope: sumR=sumF; sumMoments=0 per face and loadcase
rules.applicability: holes,edges,cantilevers and excluded ties must be explicit

rules.name: Release gating
rules.equation_or_scope: design revision + all checks + independent review + authorized approval
rules.applicability: offline examples always NO_GO
